'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a female NPC found talking to '''Marcos''' and '''Numerik''' discussing about [[Lupa]]. They appear during {{Color|help|06:00-03:00}} by the elevator to enter [[Capitoline Hill City]]. 

After the event of {{Quest|Flames of Heart}}, Marccia is seen wearing a Gladiator outfit. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:;'''Marccia''' You got this, Lupa! No matter how you do in the finals, I'll always support you!
:;'''Numerik''' With her capabilities, the win's in the bag for sure! I want to get stronger too... Wish I could be in the same training room with Lupa...
:;'''Marcos''' Is she really as tough as they say she is? I mean... could there be a chance she's cheating?

:{{DIcon}} Are you talking about Lupa?
:'''Marccia''' hat's right. I'm a Lupa superfan! I've watched replays of every single one of her matches at least a million times now!
:'''Numerik''' Same here! Every time I watch those replays, I learn something new. How to handle a spear, tactics, small techniques... Feels like there's so much to learn, and they are all so practical, too.
:'''Numerik''' She's guaranteed to snatch that championship, given how much more powerful she is than everyone else.
:'''Marcos:''' I wouldn't underestimate the other contenders, though. Also, don't you find it a bit fishy how easily she wins literally every match?
:'''Numerik''' What's there to be fishy about? It's pure Lupa roflstomp! Besides, Lupa's not the cheating type!
:'''Marccia''' My thoughts as well! You watch what you say about my idol!
:'''Marcos:''' I'm just raising an educated suspicion... Don't get all worked up about it!
----
;After completing {{Quest|Flames of Heart}}
:;'''Marccia''' See? I told you all Lupa was going to win the championship!
:;'''Numerik''' Did you see her moves during the finals? I've watched the replays over and over, trying to recreate her moves.
:;'''Marcos''' I guess I was wrong about Lupa... It's all pure strength, plain and simple

:'''Marccia:''' Hey! Aren't you one of Lupa's teammates? I didn't recognize you last time. Congrats on winning the championship!
:{{DIcon}} Thanks.
::'''Marccia:''' Can't wait to see more of you guys in the future!
:{{DIcon}} Want an autograph?
::'''Marccia:''' Really?!
:'''Marccia:''' You guys were so amazing in the finals... Could you teach us some of your techniques? We wanna be great just like you!
:'''Numerik:'''Can you give me some pointers first? I've got tons of questions about that combo move you did...
:'''Marccia:''' Hey, back of the line! I was here first!
:'''Marcos:''' Can you help me tell Lupa that I'm sorry for accusing her of cheating earlier?
{{Dialogue End}}
